learned.description: Gracefully recovers a hung tmux session by sending an interrupt, spawning a recovery window, and killing the faulty one.
learned.example: tmux send-keys -t <session> C-c && sleep 2 && tmux new-window -t <session>:2 'cd ~/hive && ./run_hive.sh --recover' && tmux kill-window -t <session>:1
